purpose: Directory of public newsroom pathways for independent, evidence-based public-interest reporting. Not a mailing list, allegation distribution mechanism or substitute for formal complaints.
editorial_use: Select outlets by geographic and editorial fit, not by number of recipients. Use one appropriate newsroom route; respect shared networks and avoid duplicative or repeated unsolicited messages.

A tip should distinguish firsthand observations, verifiable documentation, disputed allegations, inferences and the requested independent inquiry. Do not state unverified allegations as established findings.

Ask a newsroom about confidentiality before sharing sensitive personal or medical records. Ordinary email and most web forms are not encrypted; use the newsroom's own current confidential-submission guidance. Do not commit records or identities of confidential sources to the public repository.
Publication permission and confidentiality differ by outlet. Never assume off-the-record treatment unless agreed with the journalist. Some general contact pages are not dedicated tip routes.

No personal reporter contact harvest, unrelated contacts, automated dispatch, implied endorsement or reported acceptance. A press report does not file or extend any regulatory complaint or legal deadline.
